outputs.title:0: Skip Hinnant Dies: ‘Electric Company’, ‘You’re A Good Man, Charlie Brown’ Actor, Voice Of Fritz The Cat Was 86
outputs.excerpt:0: Skip Hinnant, an original cast member of PBS’ The Electric Company in the 1970s and the prolific voice actor behind Fritz the Cat, My Little Pony and 1977’s stop-motion Easter Bunny, died Sunday, November 8, in Denver. He was 86. His death was announced by his family, who noted…
outputs.block:1:text:0: His death was announced by his family, who noted he passed peacefully surrounded by loved ones.
